episodes.title: Random Acts of Mayhem
episodes.summary: Promised total transformation, nine very different people arrive at Tranquillum House, a secluded retreat run by the mysterious wellness guru Masha.

episodes.title: The Critical Path
episodes.summary: As healing begins, the guests begin to doubt the retreat's unconventional methods. They came for massages and relaxation, not to face their own mortality.

episodes.title: Earth Day
episodes.summary: Forced to live "off of the land" on Earth Day, tension within the group erupts as treatment intensifies and hunger pains set in.

episodes.title: Brave New World
episodes.summary: As the guests learn more about Tranquillum's unique protocols, everyone must decide if they will continue under Masha's care. Meanwhile, Masha is receiving mysterious threats of her own.

episodes.title: Sweet Surrender
episodes.summary: Zoe's birthday celebration reopens old wounds, even as the group begins to grow closer.

episodes.title: Motherlode
episodes.summary: As the protocol escalates, relationships are strengthened, even as the effects of the treatment become more unsettling. Masha reveals her unique treatment goals for the Marconi family.

episodes.title: Wheels on the Bus
episodes.summary: Pressure on Masha intensifies, as she juggles the competing needs of her guests, discord amongst her staff and her absolute commitment to healing the Marconi family.

episodes.title: Ever After
episodes.summary: It's time for everyone to cross the threshold and face their demons, including Masha. But will they make it to other side?

episodes.title: Zauberwald
episodes.summary: In their search for mind and body reinvigoration, nine people from various walks of life arrive at Zauberwald, an Alpine retreat, where they are greeted by the enigmatic wellness guru, Masha.

episodes.title: The Crabapple Clubhouse
episodes.summary: After a rocky first night, the guests go on a foraging mission around the retreat, but one member of the Zauberwald team has concerns about Masha's specially invited latecomer.

episodes.title: The Field Trip
episodes.summary: Martin escorts the guests to a museum in a nearby picturesque town – a trip that sees the healing protocol take hold with varying effects.

episodes.title: The Major Lift
episodes.summary: Tina and Wolfie's relationship is put under strain when the Zauberwald ballroom is set up with musical instruments. Victoria offers to have a girls' night in with Imogen, but the plan goes awry.

episodes.title: Prague
episodes.summary: Masha takes David on a psychedelic tour of their past together.

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.summary: Matteo confronts Victoria about the secret she has been keeping from Imogen, while Peter is shaken by a new revelation.

episodes.title: Mergers and Acquisitions
episodes.summary: Helena's past enters the spotlight as Martin spills the beans about Zauberwald's history and possible future.

episodes.title: Never Change
episodes.summary: The strangers finally realize what has brought them together.
